title: Dharma Devathai
desc: A union leader of a factory is killed by his evil employer for provoking the workers to fight for their rights. However, the former's brother decides to avenge the wrong done to his sibling.

title: Thangathin Thangam
desc: A young village leader falls in love with a girl assuming that she is a villager. However, his life takes a turn when he comes to know that she is from a very rich family and a friend of his enemy.

title: Rudhra
desc: Mayandi kills inspector Gopal and his family except for Rudhra, who finds evidence against him and shows it to the police. However, when an officer begins torturing her, Rudhra vows to kill Mayandi.

title: Padikkathavan
desc: When a man is away on a business trip his wife forces his two young stepbrothers out of the house where one of them gets tangled up with drug dealers.
